geoparquet.reason: Retain every native ID/field/type and mixed Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry without historical schema/ID conversion.

parameters.coherence: before/after full schema/count/ID/attribute observations equal; no transactional snapshot/atomicity claimed
parameters.geometry: all ordered rings/vertices retained; no projection, densification, coordinate rounding, orientation change, Polygon wrapping or repair
parameters.physical_types: esriFieldTypeOID/Integer→int32, Double→float64, String→UTF8; original declarations/length/nullability retained in sidecar
parameters.source_ID: objectid retained exactly; separate prior id not substituted

unsupported_output_formats.pmtiles: No approved cartographic field/ID/geometry contract; preserve native lossless outputs and all original baseline PMTiles bytes.
unsupported_output_formats.shapefile_zip: Native Shape__Area/Shape__Length names cannot be retained in Shapefile; no approved truncation/type/ID mapping.
